subject: Private deployment pricing: service-credit matrix & invoicing plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@meditech.com>
Cc: procurement@meditech.com
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing: service-credit matrix & invoicing plan

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As promised, attached is a short matrix that frames two levers we can use to hit your budget: (1) implementation/service credits and (2) amortization of the annual platform fee across the first 12 months.

High-level proposal (attached as redwood_vpc_service_credit_matrix_v1.pdf):
- Option A: 25% implementation credit applied to first invoice; platform fee billed upfront but amortized across 12 monthly invoices.
- Option B: 40% implementation credit with a 6-month amortization on platform fee; requires 18-month commitment.

We can also phase SKU activation so you only pay for active node licenses in months 1–3 and then ramp to full capacity. That helps you manage cashflow while we complete the integration work.

Would you prefer Option A with a smaller credit and shorter target amortization or Option B (larger credit but longer commit)? If you send a quick note on your procurement constraints I can tailor an invoice schedule and push the SOW draft to you (attached).

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

Attachments: redwood_vpc_service_credit_matrix_v1.pdf, SOW-draft-MediTech.docx

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@meditech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meditech.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing: service-credit matrix & invoicing plan

Sean —

Thanks for the note and the matrix. Procurement reviewed quickly this morning. A few constraints from our side:
- Budget window closes end of Q3; we need no large upfront hits in July.
- Capital approval prefers multi-month amortization over upfront platform fees.
- We can commit to a 12–18 month term but need the first-year Opex impact to be below $450k.

Could you produce a sample invoice schedule that shows: (a) first invoice with implementation credit applied, (b) monthly amortized platform fee line, and (c) month-by-month node licensing as we phase up over 3 months?

Also: any flexibility on reducing the platform-fee rate for year one if we take the 18-month commitment? That would help internal approvers.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of Procurement — MediTech Systems
aisha.khan@meditech.com
procurement@meditech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private deployment pricing: service-credit matrix & invoicing plan

Sean / Irene —

Quick internal note after reading Aisha's asks. Proposed counter we can present that balances revenue recognition and their Opex constraints:

Proposed commercial structure to offer MediTech
- Implementation credit: 30% of initial implementation invoice, applied to invoice #1.
- Platform fee: list $180k/year, amortized monthly over 12 months (so $15k/month) on the invoicing schedule for year one. For an 18-month term we can step the year-two platform fee down 10% as a loyalty concession.
- Phased SKU activation: Month 1 = 40% node capacity, Month 2 = 70%, Month 3 = 100%. Node licensing billed monthly for active capacity.
- Support tier: mid-tier (24x7 with 4-hour response) included at a 20% discount for year one.

Irene — need confirmation on the revenue/recognition impact of absorbing a 30% credit and amortizing platform fee for accounting. If accepted, I'll draft the revised invoice schedule and update SOW-draft-MediTech.docx accordingly.

Proposed next steps:
1) Approve credit % and amortization window (Sean).
2) Send the sample invoice schedule to Aisha.
3) If accepted, prepare DocuSign package for signatures.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@meditech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, procurement@meditech.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing: service-credit matrix & invoicing plan

Aisha —

Following Marissa's internal recommendation, here's the formal offer we can present to Procurement (summary plus invoice schedule attached):

Offer summary:
- Implementation credit: 30% applied to the first invoice (covers integration SOW milestone 1).
- Platform fee: $180k/year amortized over 12 months for year one (line item of $15k/month). We will reduce the year-two platform fee by 10% if MediTech signs an 18-month commitment.
- Phased activation billing: Month 1 = 40% node licensing; Month 2 = 70%; Month 3 = 100%.
- Support: Mid-tier 24x7 support at 20% discount for the first 12 months.

Attached: redwood_vpc_service_credit_matrix_v1.pdf (updated with the numbers above) and SOW-draft-MediTech.docx (SOW updated to reflect milestone-based billing).

If this aligns with your approvals I can package the invoice schedule and SOW into a DocuSign packet: https://www.docusign.com/packet/MT-7831-sign.

Two quick clarifications: (1) the implementation credit is applied only against Redwood line items (implementation and runbook professional services), not third-party cloud pass-through costs; (2) amortization in our invoices is an internal billing arrangement — full platform fee remains due across the committed term per contract.

Looking forward — can we aim to close this by end of next week to hit your Q3 budget window?

Best,
Sean
